description.value:
One shot, placed exactly. The scrap-rifle culture's answer to a world where ammunition is worth more than the people carrying it.

SIGNATURE — bonus precision damage against your Marked quarry, scaling as the Mark holds longer.

cinderfall.incomplete: The Mark itself is now built (waywarden.mark-quarry.json grants TokenMark slug 'quarry'; target:mark:quarry is live). The remaining blocker is entirely this card's own text: it's exactly Ranger's Precision classfeature's shape (DamageDice, category "precision", selector strike-damage, predicate target:mark:quarry, diceNumber scaling on a tracked variable -- see waywarden.quarrys-bane.json for the level-gated ternary pattern already built this pass), but "scaling as the Mark holds longer" is not a formula -- it names a variable (rounds/turns the current Mark has been active) that isn't @actor.level and has no stated starting die, growth rate, or cap. Owner will supply the actual numbers.
